description: §260 — capability for per-plugin sandbox WebviewWindows (label plugin-*). Grants ONLY the sandbox message transport (plugin_sandbox_connect: hand the host an inbound ipc::Channel; plugin_sandbox_report: outbound, with the plugin id stamped from the caller's window label) plus the single privileged broker command plugin_call. Every other #[tauri::command] is ACL-gated (Phase 3b AppManifest) and withheld here, so a sandbox webview cannot invoke fs/keyring/llm/git/etc. directly — only the authorizer-checked plugin_call. Phase 3c-2a additionally withholds core:event:* — Tauri delivers every broadcast event to a JS listener registered with the default EventTarget::Any, and emit_to/emit_filter cannot withhold it (match_any_or_filter, tauri/src/event/listener.rs), so allow-listen here would let a zero-capability plugin eavesdrop on llm:token, file:changed and friends. Host-only plugin_sandbox_register/deregister/send are intentionally NOT granted here (host windows only). NOT the whole reachable surface: tauri hardcodes an ACL bypass for FETCH_CHANNEL_DATA_COMMAND (plugin:__TAURI_CHANNEL__|fetch, see webview/mod.rs 'TODO: Remove this special check in v3'), which any webview may invoke with only a guessable sequential id — so a sandbox can race and steal/wedge another sandbox's channel frame once a frame exceeds tauri's 8 KiB direct-eval threshold. Frames stay far below it and SandboxChannels::send warns in dev if that changes.
